unit.title: Integers & Absolute Value
unit.essential_question: How do signed numbers describe position, direction, change, and distance—and how do their operation rules preserve meaning?
big_ideas: An integer's sign communicates direction or position relative to a reference point.
Opposites have equal absolute value because they are equally distant from zero.
Integer operations can be justified with number lines, zero pairs, patterns, and context.
Subtraction can be understood as adding the opposite.
Coordinates and signed change connect integer reasoning to graphs, finance, science, weather, and movement.

lessons.title: Integers in Context & on the Number Line
objectives: Interpret positive and negative integers in real contexts.
Place integers accurately on a number line.
Identify zero as a reference point rather than a positive or negative value.
Translate words such as rise, fall, credit, debt, above, and below into signed numbers.

lessons.title: Opposites, Absolute Value & Distance
objectives: Identify opposites and additive inverses.
Interpret absolute value as distance from zero.
Find distance between two integer positions.
Distinguish a signed value from its magnitude.

lessons.title: Comparing & Ordering Integers
objectives: Compare integers using <, >, and =.
Order sets of positive and negative integers.
Use number-line position to justify comparisons.
Interpret comparisons correctly in context.

lessons.title: Adding Integers with Models & Meaning
objectives: Add integers using number-line movement.
Use zero pairs to model sums with unlike signs.
Select and justify an efficient addition strategy.
Interpret integer sums as combined changes or positions.

lessons.title: Subtracting Integers: Add the Opposite
objectives: Rewrite subtraction as addition of the opposite.
Subtract integers accurately using models and rules.
Interpret subtraction as change or distance.
Identify and correct common sign errors.

lessons.title: Multiplying & Dividing Integers
objectives: Multiply and divide integers accurately.
Explain sign rules using patterns and repeated change.
Distinguish operation signs from number signs.
Solve contextual problems involving repeated gains, losses, and rates.

lessons.title: Coordinate Plane & Signed Change
objectives: Plot and identify ordered pairs in all four quadrants.
Interpret signs of x- and y-coordinates.
Describe horizontal and vertical signed change.
Use coordinates to model location, routes, and data.

lessons.title: Multi-Step Integer Expressions & Applications
objectives: Evaluate multi-step expressions containing integers.
Apply order of operations with signed values.
Model and solve multi-stage contextual problems.
Estimate the sign and approximate magnitude before calculating.

practice.title: Foundation Practice
practice.description: Scaffolded integer models, number lines, hints, and smaller steps.

practice.title: Core Practice
practice.description: Complete unit-level practice across all integer skills.

practice.title: Extended Practice
practice.description: Unfamiliar contexts, counterexamples, coordinate reasoning, and multi-step challenges.
